title.zh: 卷三十九 本紀第三十九 寧宗三
title.raw: 卷三十九 本紀第三十九 寧宗三 Volume 39 Annals 39: Ningzong 3

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年春正月戊寅，右諫議大夫葉時等請梟韓侂胄首於兩淮以謝天下，不報。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the first year of Jiading, on the day wuyin, Right Remonstrance Censor Ye Shi and others requested that Han Tuozhou's head be displayed at the two Huai regions to satisfy the empire; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Jiading (1208), on the day wuyin, Right Remonstrance Censor Ye Shi and others asked that Han Tuozhou's head be publicly displayed in the two Huai regions as an act of atonement to the realm; the court did not act on the request.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，下詔求言。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, an edict was issued soliciting remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, the throne issued an edict inviting counsel and criticism.

sentences.zh: 壬午，王柟還自河南，持金人牒，求韓侂胄首。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Wang Tan returned from Henan, bearing a Jin dispatch, requesting Han Tuozhou's head.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu, Wang Tan returned from Henan with a Jin document demanding Han Tuozhou's head.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，葉時等復請梟侂胄首於兩淮。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Ye Shi and others again requested that Tuozhou's head be displayed at the two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, Ye Shi and others renewed their request to display Tuozhou's head in the two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 戊子，安定郡王伯栩薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Prince of Anding Jun Boyu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, Prince of Anding Jun Boyu died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以史彌遠知樞密院事，以許奕爲金國通謝使。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Shi Miyuan was appointed to direct the Bureau of Military Affairs; Xu Yi was made Jin envoy for thanks and condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, Shi Miyuan was placed in charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Xu Yi was appointed envoy to the Jin state for expressions of thanks and condolence.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，追復趙汝愚觀文殿大學士，諡忠定。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wushen, Zhao Ruyu was posthumously restored as Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture, with the posthumous title Zhongding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day wushen, Zhao Ruyu was posthumously reinstated as Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and given the posthumous epithet Zhongding ("Loyal and Settled").

sentences.zh: 詔史官改紹熙以來韓侂胄事蹟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the historiographers to revise the record of Han Tuozhou's deeds from the Shaoxi era onward.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the official historians to rewrite the account of Han Tuozhou's career from the Shaoxi period onward.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔臨安府振給流民。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict ordered the Lin'an prefecture to provide relief to displaced persons.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, an edict directed the Lin'an prefectural government to distribute relief to refugees and migrants.

sentences.zh: 戊午，責授程松果州團練副吏、賓州安置。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Cheng Song was demoted and appointed deputy military training commissioner of Guo Prefecture, with residence assigned at Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, Cheng Song was stripped of rank and demoted to deputy military training commissioner of Guo Prefecture, with compulsory residence at Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，郴州黑風峒寇羅世傳作亂，招降之。

translations.literal: That month, Luo Shichuan, a bandit of Heifeng Stockade in Chen Prefecture, rebelled, and he was induced to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That month Luo Shichuan, an outlaw leader at Heifeng Stockade in Chen Prefecture, rose in revolt and was brought to surrender.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，以毛自知首論用兵，奪進士第一人恩例。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guiyou, because Mao Zizhi had been the first to advocate war, he was stripped of the privileges of top metropolitan graduate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day guiyou, Mao Zizhi—who had been foremost in urging war—was deprived of the honors accorded the first-place jinshi.

sentences.zh: 戊子，下詔戒飭內外群臣。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, an edict was issued admonishing inner and outer officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, an edict was promulgated calling inner- and outer-court officials to account.

sentences.zh: 復秦檜王爵、贈諡。

translations.literal: Qin Hui's princely rank was restored and a posthumous title was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui's princely title was restored and a posthumous epithet bestowed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王柟自軍前再還行在，議以韓侂胄函首易淮、陝侵地。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Wang Tan again returned from the front to the imperial residence; discussion turned to exchanging Han Tuozhou's head in a casket for the seized lands of Huai and Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, Wang Tan returned once more from the army to the capital, and court debated trading Han Tuozhou's head, sent in a casket, for Jin-held territory in the Huai and Shaan regions.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔梟侂胄首於兩淮。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, an edict ordered Tuozhou's head displayed at the two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, an edict commanded that Tuozhou's head be publicly displayed in the two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 是春，子垍生。

translations.literal: That spring, the son Kun was born.
translations.idiomatic: That spring a son named Kun was born to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，詔後省科別群臣奏疏可行者以聞。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day bingchen, an edict ordered the rear secretariat and various departments to sort ministers' memorials and report those that could be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day bingchen, the throne ordered rear-office departments to sort through officials' memorials, distinguish what was feasible, and report accordingly.

sentences.zh: 贈彭龜年寶謨閣直學士，落李沐寶文閣學士。

translations.literal: Peng Guinian was posthumously granted the title of Academician-on-Call of the Baomo Pavilion; Li Mu was removed from the title of Academician of the Baowen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Guinian was posthumously made Academician-on-Call of the Baomo Pavilion; Li Mu was stripped of his rank as Academician of the Baowen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 戊午，再責授陳自強復州團練副使、雷州安置，仍籍其家。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Chen Ziqiang was again demoted to deputy military training commissioner of Fu Prefecture, with residence at Lei Prefecture, and his household property was registered for confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, Chen Ziqiang was demoted a second time to deputy military training commissioner of Fu Prefecture and ordered to reside at Lei Prefecture, while his household goods were inventoried for seizure.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，賜禮部進士鄭自成以下四百二十有六人及第、出身。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinyou, 426 persons including metropolitan graduate Zheng Zicheng of the Ministry of Rites were granted pass and origin status.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day xinyou, 426 candidates including Zheng Zicheng, top graduate of the Ministry of Rites examination, received jinshi degrees and intermediate status.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, Venus traversed the celestial meridian.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以飛蝗爲災，減常膳。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, because locust swarms were a calamity, the regular palace meals were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, in response to a locust plague, the emperor reduced his daily court rations.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔侍從、台諫疏奏闕政，監司、守令條上民間利害。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict ordered attendant officials and censorial remonstrators to memorialize on governmental defects; regional supervisors and prefectural magistrates to itemize popular benefits and harms.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, the throne ordered close advisers and remonstrating censors to submit critiques of policy failures, and intendants and local magistrates to report in detail on conditions harming or helping the people.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，詔呂祖泰特補上州文學。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinchou, an edict specially enrolled Lü Zutai as a Literary Student of Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinchou, Lü Zutai was granted special enrollment as Literary Student of Shang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以丘崈同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Qiu Cong was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, Qiu Cong was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以飛蝗爲災，詔三省疏奏寬恤未盡之事。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, because locusts were a calamity, an edict ordered the three central departments to memorialize on relief measures not yet fully carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, citing the locust disaster, the throne ordered the three chief councils to report on lenient policies still incompletely implemented.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰朔，發米振貧民。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month (wuchen), rice was issued to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, grain was distributed to aid the impoverished.

sentences.zh: 辛未，丘崈卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Qiu Cong died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, Qiu Cong died.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命侍從、台諫、兩省詳議會子折閱利害。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, attendant officials, censors, and the two central secretariats were ordered to deliberate in detail on the harm and benefit of huizi paper-note depreciation.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, the emperor charged close advisers, censors, and both secretariats to study in detail the advantages and disadvantages of depreciation in huizi notes.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以禮部尚書婁機同知樞密院事，吏部尚書樓鑰簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Minister of Rites Lou Ji was made Vice Director of Military Affairs; Minister of Personnel Lou Yue was made Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, Minister of Rites Lou Ji was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Minister of Personnel Lou Yue was named Signing Secretary of the same bureau.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔禮部侍郎許奕、起居舍人曾從龍考訂監司、守令所陳民間利害，擇可行者以聞，其未上者趣之。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict ordered Vice Minister of Rites Xu Yi and Diary Drafter Zeng Conglong to collate and verify the popular benefits and harms stated by intendants and magistrates, selecting feasible items to report; those who had not yet submitted were to be urged.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, the throne directed Vice Minister Xu Yi and Diary Drafter Zeng Conglong to review magistrates' reports on popular grievances and benefits, forward what was practicable, and press officials who had not yet filed reports.

sentences.zh: 甲午，發米二十萬，振糶江、淮流民。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, 200,000 piculs of rice were issued to relieve and sell grain to displaced persons on the Yangzi and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, two hundred thousand piculs of grain were released to relieve Yangzi and Huai refugees, including through government grain sales.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，金使完顏侃、喬宇入見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinchou, Jin envoys Wanyan Kan and Qiao Yu were received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day xinchou, the Jin envoys Wanyan Kan and Qiao Yu were granted audience.

sentences.zh: 壬子，出安邊所錢一百萬緡，命江、淮制置大使司糴米振饑民。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, 1 million strings of cash from the border-stabilization office were issued; the Jiang-Huai pacification commissionerate was ordered to purchase grain to relieve famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, one million strings were drawn from the border-stabilization fund and the Jiang-Huai pacification commissionerate was instructed to buy grain to feed the starving.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔以和議成諭天下。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, an edict announced to the realm that peace had been concluded.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, an edict proclaimed throughout the empire that a peace settlement had been reached.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣曾從龍使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Zeng Conglong was dispatched as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, Zeng Conglong was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大風。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, great wind.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, a violent windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 赦沿邊諸州。

translations.literal: A general pardon was granted to all border prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Border prefectures along the frontier were granted amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，以錢象祖爲左丞相，史彌遠爲右丞相。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingzi, Qian Xiangzu was made Left Chief Councilor, Shi Miyuan Right Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingzi, Qian Xiangzu was appointed Left Chief Councilor and Shi Miyuan Right Chief Councilor.

sentences.zh: 雷孝友知樞密院事仍兼參知政事，婁機參知政事，樓鑰同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Lei Xiaoyou directed the Bureau of Military Affairs while also serving as Vice Grand Councilor; Lou Ji was Vice Grand Councilor; Lou Yue was Vice Director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Xiaoyou directed the Bureau of Military Affairs while retaining his post as Vice Grand Councilor; Lou Ji and Lou Yue were appointed Vice Grand Councilor and Vice Director of Military Affairs respectively.

sentences.zh: 己卯，褒錄慶元上書楊宏中等六人。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Yang Hongzhong of the six who had submitted memorials in Qingyuan was honored and recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, six men including Yang Hongzhong, who had submitted memorials during the Qingyuan era, were officially commended and entered in the record.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，封伯柷爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Bo Fu was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, Bo Fu was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，蔡璉除名，配贛州牢城。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Cai Lian was expunged from the rolls and assigned to the prison garrison at Gan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, Cai Lian was struck from the registers and sent to penal service at the Ganzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 癸未，金遣使來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the Auspicious Celebration festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, Jin envoys arrived to offer felicitations on the Auspicious Celebration festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，金主璟殂。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingchen, the Jin ruler Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day bingchen, the Jin emperor Jing died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，史彌遠以母憂去位。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Shi Miyuan left office due to mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, Shi Miyuan resigned his post to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，錢象祖罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuchen, Qian Xiangzu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day wuchen, Qian Xiangzu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚午，四川初行當五大錢。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Sichuan for the first time circulated the dangwu large coin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, Sichuan first put into circulation the large denomination "matched-five" coin.

sentences.zh: 升嘉興府爲嘉興軍。

translations.literal: Jiaxing Prefecture was promoted to Jiaxing Military Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxing Prefecture was elevated to Jiaxing Military Prefecture status.

sentences.zh: 再奪李沐三官、信州居住。

translations.literal: Li Mu was again stripped of three ranks and ordered to reside at Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mu was demoted three more ranks and ordered to live in exile at Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，改命曾從龍使金弔祭。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Zeng Conglong's mission was changed to an envoy to the Jin for mourning sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, Zeng Conglong's assignment was changed to leading Jin mourning rites on behalf of the Song court.

sentences.zh: 己卯，黎州蠻畜卜寇邊。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the Liao Prefecture barbarian Xubu raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, the tribal leader Xubu of Li Prefecture raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣宇文紹彭使金賀即位。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Yuwen Shaopeng was dispatched as envoy to congratulate the Jin on the enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, Yuwen Shaopeng was sent to the Jin court to congratulate the new emperor's accession.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，蠲兩淮州軍二稅一年。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the two taxes of Huai regions were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, the two principal taxes in the two Huai regions were waived for one year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江、淮制置司汰雄淮軍歸農，淮東揀刺八千餘人以補鎮江大軍及武鋒軍之闕，淮西揀刺二萬六千餘人以爲御前定武軍。

translations.literal: That year, the Jiang-Huai pacification commission dismissed Xiong Huai Army troops to return to farming; in eastern Huai more than 8,000 were selected to fill vacancies in the Zhenjiang grand army and Wufeng Army; in western Huai more than 26,000 were selected to form the imperial Dingwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Jiang-Huai commissionerate released Xiong Huai Army soldiers to civilian farming; in Huai East over eight thousand men were drafted to fill gaps in the main Zhenjiang army and the Wufeng Army, while in Huai West more than twenty-six thousand were chosen to form the imperial Dingwu Army.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚子，詔內外有司疏陳節用之事。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year, on the day gengzi, an edict ordered inner and outer offices to memorialize on thrift matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year of Jiading, on the day gengzi, offices at court and in the provinces were ordered to propose measures for economizing expenditures.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，金遣裴滿正來告哀。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Jin sent Puman Zheng to announce the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, the Jin dispatched Puman Zheng to announce the late emperor's death.

sentences.zh: 丁己，以樓鑰參知政事，御史中丞章良能知樞同密院事，吏部尚書宇文紹節簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Lou Yue was made Vice Grand Councilor; Censor-in-Chief Zhang Liangneng directed the Bureau of Military Affairs; Minister of Personnel Yuwen Shaojie was Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, Lou Yue was appointed Vice Grand Councilor, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Liangneng was placed in charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Minister of Personnel Yuwen Shaojie became its Signing Secretary.

sentences.zh: 庚申，金遣蒲察知剛來獻遺留物。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Jin sent Pucha Zhigang to present leftover goods of the deceased.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, the Jin envoy Pucha Zhigang arrived bearing items left by the deceased emperor.

sentences.zh: 詔侍從、兩省、台諫各舉監司、郡守治行尤異者二三人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered attendants, the two secretariats, and remonstrators each to recommend two or three intendants and prefects of exceptionally fine governance.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered close advisers, both secretariats, and remonstrating officials each to nominate two or three intendants or prefects whose conduct in office was outstanding.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，金遣使來告即位。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jisi, the Jin sent envoys to announce the enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day jisi, Jin envoys arrived to announce their new emperor's accession.

sentences.zh: 庚午，黎州蠻寇邊。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Li Prefecture barbarians raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, tribal forces from Li Prefecture again raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以會子折閱日甚，詔侍從、兩省以下各疏奏所見。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, because huizi depreciation grew daily worse, an edict ordered attendants and all below the two secretariats to memorialize their views.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu, as depreciation of huizi notes worsened by the day, officials from close advisers down through the secretariats were ordered to submit their views in writing.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，罷法科試經義，復六場舊法。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the law section examination of classical exegesis was abolished and the old six-session method restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, the legal examinations' test on classical interpretation was abolished and the former six-round format reinstated.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大風。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, great wind.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, a violent wind struck.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingshen, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day bingshen, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 巳酉，詔民以減會子之直籍沒家財者，有司立還之。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, an edict ordered that for commoners whose household property had been confiscated for reducing huizi value, the offices should immediately return it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou, the throne ordered officials to restore at once the confiscated property of subjects punished for discounting huizi notes.

sentences.zh: 戊午，禁兩淮官吏私買民田。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, officials in the two Huai regions were forbidden to purchase commoners' land privately.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, private purchase of peasant land by officials in the two Huai regions was banned.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命浙西及沿江諸州給流民病者藥。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the western Zhejiang and Yangzi-bank prefectures were ordered to supply medicine to sick displaced persons.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, prefectures of western Zhejiang and along the Yangzi were directed to provide medicine to ailing refugees.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷漳、泉、福三州、興化軍賣廢寺田。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, sale of abandoned temple lands in Zhang, Quan, and Fu prefectures and Xinghua Military Prefecture was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, the sale of defunct temple lands in Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, Fuzhou, and Xinghua district was suspended.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，出內庫錢十萬緡爲臨安貧民棺槥費。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, 100,000 strings from the inner treasury were issued for coffin expenses of Lin'an's poor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, one hundred thousand strings from the imperial storehouse were allocated for coffins for Lin'an's impoverished dead.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，詔諸路監司督州縣捕蝗。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yichou, an edict ordered route supervisors to press prefectures and counties to catch locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yichou, provincial intendants were ordered to compel local governments to carry out locust eradication.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，江、淮制置司言，放廬、濠二州忠義軍歸農。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Jiang-Huai commission reported that the Loyal and Righteous Armies of Lu and Hao prefectures were released to return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, the Jiang-Huai commissionerate reported that Loyal and Righteous Army units in Lu and Hao prefectures had been disbanded to return to agriculture.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賜臨安諸軍死者棺錢。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, coffin money was granted to the dead of the various Lin'an armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, burial allowances were granted for soldiers of the Lin'an garrisons who had died.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜楊震仲諡曰節毅。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Yang Zhenzhong was granted the posthumous title Jieyi ("Stem and Resolute").
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, Yang Zhenzhong was posthumously entitled Jieyi, "Steadfast and Firm."

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，史彌遠起復。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingshen, Shi Miyuan resumed office from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day bingshen, Shi Miyuan returned to duty from bereavement leave.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以旱，詔諸路監司決系囚，劾守令之貪殘者，戊戌，借補訓武郎羅日願謀爲變，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, because of drought an edict ordered route supervisors to decide detained prisoners and impeach greedy magistrates; on the day wuxu, the provisionally appointed Drill and Martial Gentleman Luo Riyuan plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, drought prompted an edict requiring intendants to resolve backlogged cases and impeach corrupt local officials; on the following day, wuxu, Luo Riyuan, a provisionally appointed drill officer, was discovered plotting sedition and put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔侍從、兩省、台諫各舉監司、郡守有政績才望者二人，以補郎官之闕。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, an edict ordered attendants, two secretariats, and remonstrators each to recommend two intendants or prefects with administrative merit and reputation to fill vacancies among palace gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, close advisers, both secretariats, and censors were each told to nominate two accomplished intendants or prefects to fill vacant palace posts.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，申命州縣捕蝗。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, counties and prefectures were again ordered to catch locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, local governments were again instructed to conduct locust suppression.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔兩淮、荊襄守令以戶口多寡爲殿最。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict ordered Huai and Jingxiang magistrates to be ranked by household population as highest and lowest merit.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, magistrates in the two Huai regions and Jingxiang were to be evaluated with household counts as the primary standard of performance.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，釋大理、三衙、臨安府、兩浙州縣杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, prisoners below the rod-punishment level were released in the Court of Judicial Review, the three palace guards, Lin'an prefecture, and Zhejiang prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, prisoners liable to beating or lesser penalties were released from the judiciary, palace guards, Lin'an, and Two-Zhejiang jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 除茶鹽賞錢。

translations.literal: The tea-salt reward tax was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The supplementary levy on tea and salt was repealed.

sentences.zh: 己未，以旱，詔群臣上封事。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, because of drought, an edict ordered the multitude of officials to submit sealed memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, drought led the throne to invite sealed policy recommendations from the officialdom.

sentences.zh: 庚申，禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, ancestral temples, and altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, the court prayed at the altars of Heaven and Earth, the imperial ancestors, and the state soil-and-grain shrines.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥朔，命浙西諸州諭民種麻豆，毋督其租。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day guihai, western Zhejiang prefectures were ordered to instruct the people to plant hemp and beans and not to press them for rent.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, western Zhejiang authorities were told to encourage planting of hemp and legumes and to refrain from pressing rent collection.

sentences.zh: 詔台省及諸路監司速決滯獄。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the censorate and route supervisors swiftly to decide stagnant cases.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate and provincial intendants were ordered to expedite backlogged legal cases.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，奉安成肅皇后神御于景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Empress Chengsu's spirit image was installed in Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, Empress Chengsu's spirit tablet was enshrined in Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣俞應符賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Yu Yingfu was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, Yu Yingfu was sent to the Jin court with birthday felicitations for the emperor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，復禱雨於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, rain prayers were again offered at Heaven and Earth, ancestral temples, and altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, the court again prayed for rain at the celestial, ancestral, and state altars.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命江西、福建、二廣豐稔諸州糴運以給臨安，仍償其費。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the plentiful prefectures of Jiangxi, Fujian, and the two Guang were ordered to purchase and transport grain to supply Lin'an, with costs reimbursed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, prosperous prefectures in Jiangxi, Fujian, and the two Guang provinces were ordered to buy and ship grain to Lin'an, with transport costs reimbursed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，京湖制置司言，放諸州新軍及忠義人歸農。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the Jing-Hu pacification commission reported that new armies and loyalists of various prefectures were released to farming.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, the Jing-Hu commissionerate reported that newly recruited troops and loyalist militia in various prefectures had been sent back to farming.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，命有司舉行寬恤之政五條。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guisi, the offices were ordered to implement five articles of lenient relief policy.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day guisi, government agencies were instructed to put into effect five measures of humane relief.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔荒歉州縣七歲以下男女聽異姓收養，著爲令。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, an edict permitted boys and girls under seven in famine prefectures and counties to be adopted across surnames, established as statute.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, children under seven in famine-stricken districts were allowed to be adopted across clan lines, and the rule was codified as law.

sentences.zh: 己亥，蠲信陽、荊門、漢陽軍民賦。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, levies on the people of Xinyang, Jingmen, and Hanyang Military Prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, taxes on the populace of Xinyang, Jingmen, and Hanyang district were waived.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命兩淮轉運司給諸州民麥種。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the two Huai transport commissions were ordered to supply wheat seed to the people of various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, the Huai transport offices were directed to distribute wheat seed to farmers in the affected prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，募民以振饑免役。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the people were recruited for famine relief with corvée exemption.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, civilians were recruited for famine-relief labor with exemption from compulsory service.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，聽兩淮諸州民行鐵錢於沿江八州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiazi, the people of Huai prefectures were permitted to use iron cash in the eight prefectures along the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day jiazi, residents of the two Huai regions were authorized to circulate iron coin in eight Yangzi-bank prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以安丙爲四川制置大使，罷宣撫司。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, An Bing was made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner-in-Chief; the military commissionerate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, An Bing was appointed chief Sichuan pacification commissioner and the separate pacification commissioner's office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，冊皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the heir apparent was enfeoffed and titled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, the crown prince was formally invested.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，皇太子謁于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the crown prince paid court at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, the crown prince performed rites of homage at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔皇太子更名詢。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict ordered the crown prince to change his name to Xun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, the throne commanded that the crown prince take the name Xun.

sentences.zh: 己卯，黎州蠻復寇邊。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Li Prefecture barbarians again raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, tribal forces from Li Prefecture again raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，發米十萬石振兩淮饑民。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, 100,000 piculs of rice were issued to relieve famine victims in the two Huai regions.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, one hundred thousand piculs of grain were distributed to feed the starving in the two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，朝獻于景靈宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jihai, the court offered tribute at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jihai, the court presented offerings at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，朝享於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the court offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, the court performed the ancestral sacrifice at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，合祭天地於明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Bright Hall, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, a joint rite to Heaven and Earth was held in the Bright Hall, followed by a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丙午，增太學內舍生十員。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, ten Inner Lodge students of the Imperial Academy were added.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, ten places were added for Inner Lodge students at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命吏部郎官劉爚等審定中外所陳會子利害，上於朝。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Ministry of Personnel Gentleman Liu Can and others were ordered to examine and fix the benefits and harms of huizi stated inside and outside the court, and report to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, Liu Can of the Ministry of Personnel and others were charged to review court and provincial reports on huizi policy and submit their findings.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣費培使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Fei Pei was dispatched as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, Fei Pei was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，命京湖制置司募逃卒及放散忠義以補廂、禁軍闕。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingmao, the Jing-Hu pacification commission was ordered to recruit deserters and discharged loyalists to fill vacancies in the metropolitan and garrison armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingmao, the Jing-Hu commissionerate was directed to recruit deserters and released loyalist troops to fill gaps in palace guard and garrison units.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，金遣使來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the Auspicious Celebration festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, Jin envoys arrived to offer felicitations on the Auspicious Celebration festival.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命兩淮轉運司給諸州民稻種。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the two Huai transport commissions were ordered to supply rice seed to the people of various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, the Huai transport offices were directed to distribute rice seed to farmers in the affected prefectures.

sentences.zh: 減公私房廊白地錢什之三。

translations.literal: The tax on vacant land in official and private corridor shops was reduced by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on vacant shopfront and corridor land held by officials and private parties were cut by thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯朔，沔州統制張林等謀作亂，事覺，貸死除名、廣南羈管。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day xinmao, Mian Prefecture commander Zhang Lin and others plotted rebellion; when discovered, they were spared death but expunged from the rolls and placed under restraint in southern Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, Zhang Lin, commander at Mian Prefecture, and others were caught plotting revolt; their lives were spared but they were struck from the registers and exiled under guard to southern Guang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔浙西監司募饑民修水利。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, an edict ordered western Zhejiang supervisors to recruit famine victims to repair waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, western Zhejiang intendants were ordered to recruit starving civilians for hydraulic repair work.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以歲饑罷雪宴。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, because of famine that year, the Snow Banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, the annual Snow Banquet was canceled on account of famine.

sentences.zh: 是月，郴州黑風峒寇李元礪作亂，衆數萬，連破吉、郴諸縣，詔遣荊、鄂、江、池四州軍討之。

translations.literal: That month, the bandit Li Yuanli of Heifeng Stockade in Chen Prefecture rebelled with tens of thousands, successively capturing Ji and Chen counties; an edict dispatched armies of Jing, E, Jiang, and Chi prefectures to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Yuanli, an outlaw leader at Heifeng Stockade in Chen Prefecture, rose with a force of tens of thousands and overran Ji and Chen counties in succession; the throne ordered troops from Jing, E, Jiang, and Chi to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，四川制置大使司調官軍討黎州蠻，敗績。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiazi, the Sichuan pacification commission mobilized regular troops against Li Prefecture barbarians and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day jiazi, the Sichuan commissionerate sent regular forces against the Li Prefecture tribes and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜朱熹諡曰文。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Zhu Xi was granted the posthumous title Wen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, Zhu Xi was posthumously entitled Wen.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔諸州毋糴職田租。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict forbade prefectures to purchase official-field rent.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, prefectures were forbidden to buy up rent from official fields on their own account.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, Jin envoys arrived with felicitations for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路旱蝗，揚、楚、衡、郴、吉五州、南安軍盜起。

translations.literal: That year, drought and locusts struck all routes; bandits rose in Yang, Chu, Heng, Chen, and Ji prefectures and Nan'an Military Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought and locust plagues afflicted the provinces, and outlaw bands appeared in Yangzhou, Chuzhou, Hengzhou, Chenzhou, Jizhou, and Nan'an district.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲辰，下詔招諭群盜。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the third year, on the day jiachen, an edict was issued to summon and instruct all bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year of Jiading, on the day jiachen, the throne issued an edict offering surrender terms to outlaw bands.

sentences.zh: 又詔戒飭監司、郡守。

translations.literal: Another edict admonished supervisors and prefects.
translations.idiomatic: A further edict called intendants and prefects to account.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, dust fell from the sky like rain.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，黎州蠻復寇邊。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinyou, Li Prefecture barbarians again raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day xinyou, tribal forces from Li Prefecture again raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔楚州武鋒軍歲給累重錢，如大軍例。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, an edict ordered the Wufeng Army of Chu Prefecture to receive annual cumulative-weight pay as in the grand army precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, the Wufeng Army at Chuzhou was granted annual weight-pay supplements on the same terms as the main field armies.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以工部侍郎王居安知隆興府，督捕峒寇。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Vice Minister of Works Wang Ju'an was made prefect of Longxing and directed to supervise suppression of stockade bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu, Vice Minister Wang Ju'an was appointed prefect of Longxing and charged with directing the campaign against stockade outlaws.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，蠲都城及荒歉諸州民間逋負。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingyou, arrears owed by the people of the capital and famine-stricken prefectures were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day dingyou, private debts in the capital and famine-hit prefectures were waived.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以湖南轉運判官曹彥約知潭州，督捕峒寇。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Hunan transport vice-commissioner Cao Yueyue was made prefect of Tan Prefecture and directed to supervise suppression of stockade bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Cao Yueyue, vice-commissioner of Hunan transport, was appointed prefect of Tanzhou and charged with suppressing stockade outlaws.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賜彭龜年諡曰忠肅。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Peng Guinian was granted the posthumous title Zhongsu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, Peng Guinian was posthumously entitled Zhongsu, "Loyal and Solemn."

sentences.zh: 甲寅，誅楚州渠賊胡海。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the canal bandit Hu Hai of Chu Prefecture was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, Hu Hai, a canal outlaw of Chuzhou, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以久雨，釋兩浙州縣系囚。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, because of prolonged rain, detained prisoners in Two-Zhejiang prefectures and counties were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, prolonged rain led to the release of detained prisoners in Two-Zhejiang jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，李元礪犯南雄州，官軍大敗。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day guihai, Li Yuanli attacked Nanxiong Prefecture and government troops suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guihai, Li Yuanli struck Nanxiong Prefecture and government forces were routed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，決臨安系囚，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, detained prisoners in Lin'an were decided upon; those below rod punishment were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, backlogged cases in Lin'an were cleared and prisoners liable to beating or lesser penalties were freed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔監司、守臣安集泰、吉二州民經賊蹂踐者。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, an edict ordered supervisors and magistrates to settle the people of Tai and Ji prefectures who had been trampled by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, intendants and local officials were ordered to resettle the populace of Tai and Ji prefectures after bandit devastation.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，出內庫錢二十三萬緡賜臨安軍民。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, 230,000 strings from the inner treasury were issued as gifts to Lin'an soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, two hundred thirty thousand strings from the imperial storehouse were distributed to soldiers and civilians in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔臨安府給細民病死者棺櫬。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, an edict ordered the Lin'an prefecture to supply coffins for commoners who died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, the Lin'an government was directed to provide coffins for impoverished residents who died of disease.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，淮東賊悉平，詔寬恤殘破州縣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yiwei, bandits in eastern Huai were all pacified; an edict ordered lenient relief for devastated prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day yiwei, outlaw bands in Huai East were fully suppressed, and devastated counties were ordered humane relief measures.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以去歲旱蝗，百官應詔封事，命兩省擇可行者以聞。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, because of last year's drought and locusts, all officials responded to the edict with sealed memorials; the two secretariats were ordered to select feasible items to report.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen, citing the previous year's drought and locust disasters, officials submitted sealed memorials as ordered, and both secretariats were told to forward practicable proposals.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命沿海諸州督捕海寇。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, coastal prefectures were ordered to supervise capture of sea pirates.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, coastal prefectures were directed to hunt down sea pirates.

sentences.zh: 戊申，經理兩淮屯田。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, garrison farmland in the two Huai regions was reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, military colony lands in the two Huai regions were brought under systematic management.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以江陵忠勇軍爲御前忠勇軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the Loyal and Brave Army of Jiangling was made the Imperial Loyal and Brave Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, the Loyal and Brave Army at Jiangling was redesignated an imperial army under direct court command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以久雨，發米振貧民。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, because of prolonged rain, rice was issued to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, prolonged rain prompted the distribution of grain to aid the impoverished.

sentences.zh: 六月丁己朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day dingsi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命有司舉行寬恤之政十有九條。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the offices were ordered to implement nineteen articles of lenient relief policy.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, government agencies were instructed to put into effect nineteen measures of humane relief.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣黃中賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Huang Zhong was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Huang Zhong was sent to the Jin court with birthday felicitations for the emperor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，加楊次山少保，封永陽郡王。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Yang Cishan was promoted to Junior Mentor and enfeoffed as Prince of Yongyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, Yang Cishan was promoted to Junior Mentor and enfeoffed as Prince of Yongyang.

sentences.zh: 詔三衙、江上、四川諸軍主帥核實軍籍，期冒者以贓論。

translations.literal: An edict ordered commanders of the three palace guards, Yangzi armies, and Sichuan forces to verify military registers; those with false rolls were to be prosecuted for embezzlement.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered commanders of the palace guards, Yangzi garrisons, and Sichuan armies to audit muster rolls, with padding treated as corruption.

sentences.zh: 是月，池州副都統許俊、江州副都統劉元鼎與李元礪戰於江西，皆不利。

translations.literal: That month, Chi Prefecture deputy commander Xu Jun and Jiang Prefecture deputy commander Liu Yuanding fought Li Yuanli in Jiangxi, both with unfavorable results.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xu Jun, deputy commander at Chizhou, and Liu Yuanding, deputy commander at Jiangzhou, engaged Li Yuanli in Jiangxi and both came off badly.

sentences.zh: 知潭州曹彥約又與賊戰，亦爲所敗，賊勢愈熾。

translations.literal: Tan Prefecture magistrate Cao Yueyue again fought the bandits and was also defeated; the bandit power grew ever fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Yueyue, prefect of Tanzhou, fought the outlaws again and was likewise defeated, and their power grew stronger still.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，申嚴圍田增廣之禁。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinmao, the prohibition on enclosing and expanding polder fields was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinmao, the ban on enclosing and expanding reclaimed farmland was strictly reinforced.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，定南班爲三十員。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the southern roster was fixed at thirty posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, the southern court roster was fixed at thirty positions.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yihai, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day yihai, a violent windstorm uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 是月，臨安府蝗。

translations.literal: That month, locusts struck Lin'an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month a locust plague struck Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌朔，詔三衙、江上諸軍，升差將校必以材藝年勞，其徇私者，台諫及制置、總領劾之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day bingxu, an edict ordered that promotions of officers in the three palace guards and Yangzi armies must be based on skill and years of service; those showing favoritism were to be impeached by remonstrators, pacification commissioners, and supply chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, the throne ruled that promotions in the palace guards and Yangzi armies must rest on merit and seniority, with censors and frontier commissioners empowered to impeach favoritism.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣錢仲彪使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Qian Zhongbiao was dispatched as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, Qian Zhongbiao was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，雷。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day renshen, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day renshen, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 金遣使來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: The Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the Auspicious Celebration festival.
translations.idiomatic: Jin envoys arrived to offer felicitations on the Auspicious Celebration festival.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，推南雄州戰歿將士恩。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, favors were extended to officers and soldiers killed in battle at Nanxiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, posthumous honors and benefits were granted to officers and men who fell at Nanxiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，賞楚州平賊功。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guisi, rewards were granted for pacifying bandits at Chu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day guisi, rewards were issued for suppressing the outlaw bands at Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣朝臣二人往兩浙路與提舉官議收浮鹽。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, two court officials were dispatched to the Two-Zhejiang circuit to consult with salt commissioners on collecting floating salt.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, two court officials were sent to Two-Zhejiang to work with salt commissioners on collecting illicit salt.

sentences.zh: 是月，李元礪迫贛州、南安軍，詔以重賞募人討之。

translations.literal: That month, Li Yuanli pressed Gan Prefecture and Nan'an Military Prefecture; an edict offered heavy rewards to recruit men to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Yuanli threatened Ganzhou and Nan'an district, and the throne offered rich bounties to recruit forces against him.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，詔江、淮諸司嚴飭守令安集流民。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingchen, an edict ordered Jiang and Huai offices strictly to admonish magistrates to settle displaced persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day bingchen, Jiang and Huai authorities were ordered to press local officials to resettle refugees.

sentences.zh: 戊午，婁機罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Lou Ji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, Lou Ji was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，湖南賊羅世傳縛李元礪以降，峒寇悉平。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the Hunan bandit Luo Shichuan bound Li Yuanli and surrendered; stockade bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, the Hunan outlaw Luo Shichuan captured Li Yuanli and submitted, and stockade raiders were fully suppressed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, Jin envoys arrived with felicitations for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 黎州蠻請降。

translations.literal: Li Prefecture barbarians requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes of Li Prefecture sought to surrender.

sentences.zh: 是歲，臨安、紹興二府、嚴、衢二州大水，振之，仍蠲其賦。

translations.literal: That year, great floods struck Lin'an and Shaoxing prefectures and Yan and Qu prefectures; relief was given, and their levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year severe flooding hit Lin'an, Shaoxing, Yanzhou, and Quzhou; relief was distributed and taxes in those areas were waived.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己丑，敘州蠻攻嘉定府利店砦，陷之。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the fourth year, on the day jichou, Xu Prefecture barbarians attacked Lidian Stockade of Jiading Prefecture and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourth year of Jiading, on the day jichou, tribes from Xu Prefecture attacked Lidian Stockade in Jiading Prefecture and overran it.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以四川鹽擔錢對減激賞絹一年。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Sichuan salt-porter money was used to offset one year's reward silk.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen, Sichuan salt-transport funds were applied to reduce one year's merit-reward silk payments.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔湖南、江西諸州經賊蹂踐者，監司、守臣考縣令安集之實，第其能否以聞。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, an edict ordered that for Hunan and Jiangxi prefectures trampled by bandits, supervisors and magistrates should examine county magistrates' actual settlement work and rank their competence to report.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, intendants and prefects in Hunan and Jiangxi were told to evaluate how well county magistrates had resettled people after bandit raids and report their performance.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，李元礪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yimao, Li Yuanli was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day yimao, Li Yuanli was put to death.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，羅世傳補官，尋復叛。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Luo Shichuan was granted an official post, but soon rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, Luo Shichuan was given an official appointment, only to rebel again shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷廣西諸州牛稅。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the cattle tax in Guangxi prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, the cattle tax in Guangxi prefectures was repealed.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，大風。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day dingwei, great wind.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the day dingwei, a violent windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔諸路帥臣、監司、守令格朝廷振恤之令及盜發不即捕者，重罪之。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, an edict ordered that route commanders, supervisors, and magistrates who blocked court relief orders or failed to capture bandits immediately upon outbreak were to be heavily punished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, military governors, intendants, and local magistrates who obstructed relief edicts or failed to act promptly against outbreaks of banditry were threatened with severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，臨安府振給病民，死者賜棺錢。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiwei, Lin'an prefecture provided relief to sick commoners; the dead were granted coffin money.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day jiwei, Lin'an distributed aid to the sick, and burial allowances were granted for the dead.

sentences.zh: 丙子，沔州將劉世雄等謀據仙人原作亂，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Mian Prefecture generals Liu Shixiong and others plotted to seize Xianren Plateau and rebel; they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, Liu Shixiong and other officers at Mian Prefecture were caught plotting to seize Xianren Plateau and rise in revolt and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，禁兩浙、福建州縣科折鹽酒。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiashen, Two-Zhejiang and Fujian prefectures and counties were forbidden to levy substitute assessments on salt and wine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiashen, substitute salt and wine levies by local governments in Two-Zhejiang and Fujian were banned.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以吳曦沒官田租代輸關外四州旱傷秋稅。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, rent from confiscated official fields of Wu Xi was used to pay autumn taxes for the four prefectures outside the pass suffering drought damage.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, rent from Wu Xi's confiscated official lands was applied to cover autumn taxes for four frontier prefectures stricken by drought.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜黑風峒名曰效忠。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Heifeng Stockade was granted the name Xiaozhong ("Loyal in Effect").
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, Heifeng Stockade was renamed Xiaozhong, "Loyal in Deed."

sentences.zh: 戊申，出內庫錢瘞疫死者貧民。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, money from the inner treasury was issued to bury poor victims of the epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, funds from the imperial storehouse were allocated to bury impoverished victims of the plague.

sentences.zh: 是月，四川制置大使司置安邊司以經制蠻事，命成都路提刑李𡌴、潼川路安撫許奕共領之。

translations.literal: That month, the Sichuan pacification commission established a Border Pacification Office to manage barbarian affairs, appointing Chengdu circuit intendant Li Kan and Tongchuan circuit pacifier Xu Yi jointly to direct it.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Sichuan commissionerate set up a Border Pacification Office to oversee tribal affairs, with Li Kan of Chengdu circuit and Xu Yi of Tongchuan circuit placed in joint charge.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，賜禮部進士趙建大以下四百六十有五人及第、出身。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yihai, 465 persons including metropolitan graduate Zhao Jianda of the Ministry of Rites were granted pass and origin status.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day yihai, 465 candidates including Zhao Jianda, top graduate of the Ministry of Rites examination, received jinshi degrees and intermediate status.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，遣余嶸賀金主生辰，會金國有難，不至而還。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dinghai, Yu Song was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday; as the Jin state had troubles, he did not arrive and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day dinghai, Yu Song was sent to the Jin court with birthday felicitations, but turmoil in the Jin state kept him from reaching court and he turned back.

sentences.zh: 減京畿囚罪一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: Prisoners in the capital region had their sentences reduced one degree; those below rod punishment were released.
translations.idiomatic: Sentences in the capital region were reduced by one degree, and prisoners liable to beating or lesser penalties were freed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，更定四川諸軍軍額。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the military designations of Sichuan armies were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, the army designations of Sichuan forces were reorganized.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renxu, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renxu, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔四川官吏嘗受偽命者，自今毋得敘用。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, an edict ordered that Sichuan officials who had once accepted false appointments were from now on not to be reemployed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, Sichuan officials who had once accepted appointments from the rebel regime were permanently barred from reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔軍興以來爵賞冒濫者聽自陳，除其罪。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, an edict ordered that those who had fraudulently received ranks and rewards since the military campaigns might confess voluntarily and be absolved of guilt.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, officials who had fraudulently obtained honors since the war were offered amnesty if they confessed voluntarily.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，敘州蠻寇邊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinyou, Xu Prefecture barbarians raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day xinyou, tribes from Xu Prefecture raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，羅世傳爲其黨所殺。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Luo Shichuan was killed by his own followers.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, Luo Shichuan was slain by his own men.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣程卓使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Cheng Zhuo was dispatched as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, Cheng Zhuo was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 詔附會開邊得罪之人，自今毋得敘用。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that persons punished for conniving at frontier war were from now on not to be reemployed.
translations.idiomatic: Those punished for colluding in the frontier war were permanently barred from reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，以金國有難，命江淮、京湖、四川制置司謹邊備。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiachen, because the Jin state had troubles, the Jiang-Huai, Jing-Hu, and Sichuan pacification commissions were ordered to guard the borders carefully.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiachen, turmoil in the Jin state led the Jiang-Huai, Jing-Hu, and Sichuan commissionerates to tighten frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day jiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賞平峒寇功。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, rewards were granted for pacifying stockade bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, rewards were issued for suppressing the stockade outlaws.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，申嚴諸軍升差之制。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the regulations on army promotions were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, promotion rules for the armies were strictly reinforced.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，奉議郎張鎡坐扇搖國本除名、象州羈管。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinsi, Gentlemen for Discussion Zhang Zeng was convicted of inciting unrest over the foundation of the state, struck from the rolls, and placed under restraint and surveillance at Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day xinsi, Gentlemen for Discussion Zhang Zeng was punished for agitating over the succession: he was removed from office and exiled under surveillance to Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以會子折閱不行，遣官體訪江、浙諸州。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, because depreciated huizi paper notes would not circulate, officials were dispatched to investigate on the ground in the Jiang and Zhe prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, because devalued huizi notes were refused in trade, the court sent officials to inspect conditions in the Jiang and Zhe prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Jin dispatched envoys to offer felicitations for the New Year's Day of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, the Jin court sent envoys to congratulate the Song court on the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，金國有難，賀生辰使不至。

translations.literal: That year the Jin state was in turmoil, and the envoys sent to congratulate the ruler on his birthday did not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: That year turmoil engulfed the Jin state, and the Song mission dispatched to congratulate the Jin emperor on his birthday never reached court.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己巳，詔諸路通行兩浙倍役法，著爲令。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the fifth year, on the day jisi, an edict ordered all circuits to implement throughout the Two-Zhe double corvée law, establishing it as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fifth year (1212), on the day jisi, an edict directed every circuit to adopt the Two-Zhe double corvée system and codified it as law.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜李好義諡曰忠壯。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the posthumous title Zhongzhuang (Loyal and Stalwart) was granted to Li Haoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, Li Haoyi was given the posthumous epithet Zhongzhuang (Loyal and Stalwart).

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，罷兩淮軍興以來借補官。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renwu, offices obtained through borrowed appointment since the military rise in the two Huai were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day renwu, the court abolished provisional appointments made in the two Huai regions since the outbreak of war.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，四川制置司遣兵分道討敘州蠻，其酋米在請降。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengxu, the Sichuan Pacification Commissionerate dispatched troops by separate routes to attack the Xu Prefecture barbarians; their chieftain Mi Zai requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day gengxu, the Sichuan pacification commissionerate sent armies along several routes against the Xu Prefecture tribes; chieftain Mi Zai offered to submit.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以久雨，詔大理、三衙、臨安府、兩浙州縣決系囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, because of prolonged rain, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, the Lin'an government, and the prefectures and counties of the two Zhe to adjudicate imprisoned convicts.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, citing prolonged rains, the throne ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Palace Commands, the Lin'an prefectural government, and the Two-Zhe prefectures and counties to dispose of detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以廣東、湖南、京西盜平，監司、帥臣進職有差。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, because banditry in Guangdong, Hunan, and western Jing had been suppressed, supervising commissioners and military commissioners were advanced in rank according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, with rebellion crushed in Guangdong, Hunan, and western Jing, supervising and military commissioners received promotions graded by achievement.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸酉，安南國王李龍𣉙卒，以其子昊旵爲安南國王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the day guiyou, the king of Annam Li Longhao died; his son Hao Chan was made king of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the day guiyou, King Li Longhao of Annam died; his son Hao Chan was enthroned as king of Annam.

sentences.zh: 詔州縣見役人毋納免役錢，役滿復輸。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that prefectures and counties' currently serving corvée laborers were not to pay exemption money; after service was completed they would pay again.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade prefectures and counties from collecting corvée exemption fees from men actually performing labor; payment would resume only after the term of service ended.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，遣傅誠賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guiwei, Fu Cheng was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day guiwei, Fu Cheng was sent to offer birthday felicitations to the Jin emperor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，禁銅錢過江。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, copper cash crossing the river was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, the court prohibited copper coin from being transported south across the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，賞降敘州蠻功。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day gengshen, rewards were granted for the merit in subduing and accepting the surrender of the Xu Prefecture barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day gengshen, the court rewarded those who had pacified and received the surrender of the Xu Prefecture tribes.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以雷雨毀太廟屋，避正殿減膳。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, because thunder and rain destroyed buildings of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the emperor moved from the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, after a thunderstorm wrecked structures in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the emperor withdrew from the main palace hall and curtailed the court table.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌朔，御後殿，復膳。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month jiaxu, the emperor held court in the rear hall and restored full meals.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, the day jiaxu, the emperor resumed audience in the rear hall and restored the full court diet.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingwu, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day bingwu, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 己酉，有司上《續編中興禮書》。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the relevant offices presented the Continued Compilation of Zhongxing Ritual Codes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou, the responsible agencies submitted the Continued Compilation of Zhongxing Ritual Codes.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遵義砦夷楊煥來獻馬。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the Yi of Zunyi Stockade, Yang Huan, came to present horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, Yang Huan of the Zunyi stockade Yi presented horses in tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，罷沿海諸州海船錢。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the sea-ship levy in coastal prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, the court abolished the sea-going vessel levy along the coast.

sentences.zh: 遣應武使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: Ying Wu was dispatched as envoy to Jin to offer felicitations for New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Wu was sent to the Jin court to convey New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，詔諸路總領官歲舉堪將帥者二三人，安撫、提刑舉可備將材者各二人。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day xinsi, an edict ordered circuit general supervisors annually to recommend two or three men fit for command, and pacification and judicial commissioners each to recommend two men whose talent could supply the needs of generals.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinsi, an edict required circuit general supervisors to nominate two or three men each year as potential commanders, and pacification and judicial commissioners each to recommend two candidates suitable for military leadership.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金遣使來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Jin sent envoys to offer felicitations for the Ruiqing festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, Jin envoys arrived to congratulate the emperor on his birthday (Ruiqing Festival).

sentences.zh: 戊戌，雷。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 遣使弔祭安南。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and sacrifices for Annam.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent envoys to mourn and offer sacrifices for Annam.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，朝獻于景靈宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengshen, the emperor made offering at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day gengshen, the emperor presented offerings at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，朝饗於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the emperor held morning feast at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, the emperor performed the morning offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Circular Mound; a grand amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Circular Altar and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，再蠲濠州租稅一年。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingchou, Haozhou's land tax was remitted for another year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day dingchou, land taxes in Haozhou were remitted for a second year.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔蠲州縣橫增稅額。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict remitted arbitrarily increased tax quotas in prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu, an edict canceled unauthorized tax increases imposed by prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 己亥，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Jin sent envoys to offer felicitations for next year's New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the Song court on the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月庚申，宇文紹節卒。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the sixth year, on the day gengshen, Yuwen Shao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the sixth year (1213), on the day gengshen, Yuwen Shao died.

sentences.zh: 詔侍從、台諫、兩省官、帥守、監司各舉實才二三人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, censors and remonstrators, officials of the two central secretariats, prefectural and circuit military governors, and supervising commissioners each to recommend two or three men of genuine talent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed palace attendants, censors, officials of the Secretariat and Chancellery, prefectural and circuit governors, and supervising commissioners each to nominate two or three men of proven ability.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingchou, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day dingchou, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，有司上《嘉定編修吏部條法總類》。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the relevant offices presented the Jiading Compiled General Collection of Ministry of Personnel Statutes and Regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, the responsible agencies submitted the Jiading Compiled General Collection of Ministry of Personnel Statutes and Regulations.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔宗室毋與胥吏通姻，著爲令。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, an edict ordered that the imperial clan not contract marriage with clerical underlings, establishing this as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, an edict forbade members of the imperial clan from marrying clerks and low officials, and made the rule statutory law.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，樓鑰罷。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guihai, Lou Yue was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day guihai, Lou Yue was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，以章良能參知政事。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day bingzi, Zhang Liangneng was appointed Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day bingzi, Zhang Liangneng was appointed vice grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，復法科試經義法，雜流進納人不預。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the legal examinations were restored to test classic meaning and law; miscellaneous entrants by purchase and presentation were not to participate.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, the legal examinations again tested classical interpretation and law; men who had entered through irregular or purchased channels were excluded.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，以旱，命大理、三衙、臨安府決系囚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingmao, because of drought, the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, and the Lin'an government were ordered to adjudicate imprisoned convicts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day dingmao, owing to drought, the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Palace Commands, and the Lin'an government were ordered to dispose of detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，修慶元六年以來寬恤詔令。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, lenient relief edicts since the sixth year of Qingyuan were compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, the court compiled leniency and relief edicts issued since the sixth year of Qingyuan (1200).

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，詔刑部歲終上諸州未決之獄於尚書省，擇其最久者罪之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, an edict ordered the Ministry of Justice at year's end to report to the Department of State Affairs the unresolved cases of all prefectures, and to punish those longest delayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, an edict required the Ministry of Justice to submit to the Department of State Affairs, at year's end, every prefectural case still pending; officials responsible for the longest delays would be punished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣董居誼賀金主生辰，會金國亂，不至而還。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Dong Juyi was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday; he encountered turmoil in Jin and, unable to arrive, returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, Dong Juyi was sent to offer birthday felicitations to the Jin emperor, but turmoil in the Jin state prevented him from reaching court, and he turned back.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復監司臧否守令及監司、郡守舉廉吏所知法。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the law was restored whereby supervising commissioners appraised prefectural magistrates and supervising commissioners and prefectural governors recommended incorrupt officials they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, the court restored the practice by which supervising commissioners evaluated prefectural magistrates and both commissioners and prefects could recommend honest officials they knew.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔三衙、江上諸軍主帥各舉堪將帥者二三人。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, an edict ordered the Three Commands and commanders of armies along the river each to recommend two or three men fit for command.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen, an edict directed the Three Palace Commands and every commander of river-front armies to nominate two or three men qualified for high command.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳朔，詔諸路監司、帥臣舉所部官吏之才行卓絕、績用章著者。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month jisi, an edict ordered circuit supervising commissioners and military commissioners to recommend officials in their jurisdictions whose talent and conduct were outstanding and whose achievements were conspicuous.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, the day jisi, an edict required circuit commissioners and military governors to nominate subordinate officials of exceptional talent and distinguished service.

sentences.zh: 庚午，知思州田宗範謀作亂，夔州路安撫司遣兵討平之。
