translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Tian Zongfan, magistrate of Si Prefecture, plotted rebellion; the Kuizhou Pacification Commissionerate dispatched troops to suppress and pacify it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, Si Prefecture intendant Tian Zongfan plotted rebellion; the Kuizhou pacification commissionerate sent troops to crush the uprising.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人弑其主允濟。

translations.literal: That month, the Jin people assassinated their ruler Yunji.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin assassinated their emperor Yunji (Wanyan Yongji).

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，蠲京、湖諸州逋負二十八萬餘緡。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiachen, arrears of more than 280,000 strings in the prefectures of Jing and Hu were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jiachen, the court remitted over 280,000 strings in outstanding debts owed by prefectures in the Jing and Hu regions.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊辰朔，詔御史台置考課監司簿。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the first day of the month wuchen, an edict ordered the Censorate to establish a register for evaluating supervising commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary month, the day wuchen, an edict directed the Censorate to keep performance records on supervising commissioners.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以金主新立，命四川謹邊備。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, because the Jin ruler had newly acceded, Sichuan was ordered to guard the border carefully.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, with a new Jin emperor on the throne, the court ordered Sichuan to tighten frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔湖北監司、守令振恤旱傷。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, an edict ordered Hubei supervising commissioners and prefectural magistrates to relieve and succor drought damage.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, an edict directed Hubei commissioners and magistrates to relieve drought-stricken districts.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雷。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 甲午，史彌遠等上《三祖下七世仙源類譜》、《高宗寶訓》、《皇帝玉牒》、《會要》。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Shi Miyuan and others presented the Genealogical Compendium of Immortal Origins from the Three Ancestors through Seven Generations, the Precious Instructions of Gaozong, the Imperial Jade Genealogy, and the Essentials of Administration.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, Shi Miyuan and others submitted the Genealogical Compendium from the Three Ancestors through Seven Generations, Gaozong's Precious Instructions, the Imperial Jade Genealogy, and the Administrative Essentials.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大雷。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, great thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, violent thunder rolled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以雷發非時，下罪己詔。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, because thunder had occurred out of season, a self-reproach edict was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen, because thunder had struck out of season, the emperor issued a penitential edict blaming himself.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉朔，申嚴互送之禁。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day of the month dingyou, the prohibition on mutual gift-giving was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, the day dingyou, the court strictly reinforced the ban on officials exchanging gifts.

sentences.zh: 戊申，遣真德秀賀金主即位，會金國亂，不至而還。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Zhen Dexiu was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his accession; he encountered turmoil in Jin and, unable to arrive, returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, Zhen Dexiu was sent to congratulate the new Jin emperor on his accession, but Jin disorder blocked his way and he returned without reaching court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣李𡌴使金賀正旦，亦不至而還。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Li Qi was dispatched as envoy to Jin for New Year's Day felicitations; he likewise did not arrive and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, Li Qi was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings; he too failed to arrive and turned back.

sentences.zh: 甲子，金遣使來告即位。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Jin sent envoys to announce the accession.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, Jin envoys arrived to notify the Song court of the new emperor's enthronement.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，虛恨蠻寇嘉定府之中鎮砦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guiwei, the Xuxin barbarians raided Zhongzhen Stockade in Jiading Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day guiwei, the Xuxin tribes attacked Zhongzhen stockade in Jiading Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，蠲瓊州丁鹽錢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renyin, Qiongzhou's corvée salt tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day renyin, the court remitted the corvée salt levy in Qiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Jin sent envoys to offer felicitations for next year's New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the Song court on the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙諸州大水，振之。

translations.literal: That year, the prefectures of the two Zhe suffered great flood; they were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That year severe floods struck the Two-Zhe prefectures, and the court provided relief.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，以安丙同知樞密院事，成都府路安撫使董居誼爲四川制置使。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingmao, An Bing was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Chengdu Circuit Pacification Commissioner Dong Juyi was made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day dingmao, An Bing was made vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Dong Juyi, pacification commissioner of the Chengdu circuit, was appointed Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，金國來督二年歲幣。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Jin state came to press for two years' annual tribute payments.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, Jin envoys arrived to demand two years of overdue annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金人來止賀正旦使。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Jin men came to stop the New Year's Day congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, Jin officials intervened to halt the Song New Year's mission.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，蠲福建沿海諸州貧民納鹽。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day guimao, the salt payments of poor people in Fujian's coastal prefectures were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guimao, the court excused poor households along the Fujian coast from salt levies.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，太白經天。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingchou, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day dingchou, Venus crossed the meridian, an ominous sign.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜禮部進士袁甫以下五百四人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the Ministry of Rites jinshi graduates, Yuan Fu and 504 others below him, were granted passage of the examinations and entry into office.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, 504 Ministry of Rites jinshi led by Yuan Fu were granted degrees and official standing.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，以旱，命諸路州軍禱雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinchou, because of drought, all circuit prefectures and armies were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day xinchou, owing to drought, the court ordered every circuit and garrison to perform rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔諸路監司、守臣速決滯訟。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, an edict ordered circuit supervising commissioners and prefectural officials swiftly to decide delayed lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen, an edict directed circuit commissioners and prefects to adjudicate stalled cases without delay.

sentences.zh: 丙午，蠲兩浙路諸州贓賞錢。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the reward money for apprehending criminals in the Two-Zhe circuit prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, the court remitted bounty payments for captured criminals in the Two-Zhe prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬子，釋大理、三衙及兩浙路杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, prisoners subject to the cane and below in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, and the Two-Zhe circuit were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, the court freed prisoners sentenced to beating or lesser punishments in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Palace Commands, and the Two-Zhe circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，置嘉定府邊丁二千人以備蠻。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, two thousand border militia were established in Jiading Prefecture to guard against the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, the court stationed two thousand frontier militia in Jiading Prefecture to guard against tribal raids.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子朔，以左諫議大夫鄭昭先簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day of the month jiazi, Left Remonstrance Censor Zheng Zhaoxian was made Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs and acting Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, the day jiazi, Left Remonstrance Censor Zheng Zhaoxian was appointed secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs with acting powers as vice grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔省吏毋授參議官。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, an edict ordered that provincial clerks not be granted deliberative council posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, an edict forbade appointing provincial clerks to deliberative council posts.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，金人來告遷于南京。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Jin men came to announce the move to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, Jin envoys announced that the court was relocating to Nanjing (Kaifeng).

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以起居舍人真德秀奏，罷金國歲幣。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, on a memorial from Attendant Gentleman Drafting Edicts Zhen Dexiu, the annual tribute payments to the Jin state were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, acting on a memorial from Attendant Gentleman Zhen Dexiu, the court ended the annual tribute payments to Jin.

sentences.zh: 是月，夏人以書來四川，議夾攻金人，不報。

translations.literal: That month, the Western Xia people sent a letter to Sichuan proposing a pincer attack on the Jin people; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Tangut court wrote to Sichuan proposing a joint attack on the Jin; the Song court gave no reply.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳朔，罷關外四州所增方田稅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month guisi, the added equitable-field tax in the four prefectures beyond the pass was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, the day guisi, the court canceled supplemental equitable-field taxes in the four frontier prefectures beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，罷四川宣制司所補官。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, offices supplemented by the Sichuan Military Commission were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, the court abolished provisional appointments made by the Sichuan military commission.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，復建宗學。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the Imperial Clan School was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, the court reestablished the Imperial Clan School.

sentences.zh: 置博士、諭各一人，弟子員百人。

translations.literal: One Erudite and one Instructor were installed, with a student quota of one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: It appointed one erudite and one instructor, with enrollment fixed at one hundred students.

sentences.zh: 金國復來督歲幣。

translations.literal: The Jin state again came to press for annual tribute payments.
translations.idiomatic: Jin envoys again arrived to demand payment of the annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, Venus again crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 禁州縣沮壞義役。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties were forbidden to obstruct or destroy the righteous corvée system.
translations.idiomatic: The court forbade prefectures and counties from obstructing the community corvée (yiyi) system.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔以安丙爲觀文殿學士、知潭州。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict made An Bing an Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and assigned him as magistrate of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, an edict named An Bing an Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and appointed him prefect of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌朔，日有食之，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day of the month renxu, there was a solar eclipse; Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, the day renxu, a solar eclipse occurred and Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，史彌遠等上《高宗中興經武要略》。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Shi Miyuan and others presented the Essential Summary of Gaozong's Zhongxing Military Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, Shi Miyuan and others submitted the Essential Summary of Gaozong's Restoration Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，調殿前司兵增戍天長縣。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, troops of the Palace Front Command were shifted to increase the garrison at Tianchang County.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, the court transferred Palace Front Command troops to reinforce the garrison at Tianchang County.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以久雨，釋大理、三衙、臨安府杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, because of prolonged rain, prisoners subject to the cane and below in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, and the Lin'an government were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, citing prolonged rains, the court freed prisoners sentenced to beating or lesser punishment in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Palace Commands, and Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，釋兩浙路杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, prisoners subject to the cane and below in the Two-Zhe circuit were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, the court released prisoners sentenced to beating or lesser punishment throughout the Two-Zhe circuit.

sentences.zh: 除茶鹽賞錢。

translations.literal: The reward money for tea and salt was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tea and salt bounty payments were remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰朔，出內帑錢振臨安府貧民。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day of the month renchen, funds from the inner treasury were issued to relieve the poor of Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, the day renchen, the court disbursed inner-treasury funds to relieve the poor in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉朔，遣聶子述使金賀正旦，刑部侍郎劉爚等及太學諸生上章言其不可，不報。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day of the month xinyou, Nie Zishu was dispatched as envoy to Jin for New Year's Day felicitations; Vice Minister of Justice Liu Yao and others and students of the Imperial University submitted memorials saying this was inadvisable; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, the day xinyou, Nie Zishu was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings; Vice Minister Liu Yao and Imperial University students jointly petitioned against the mission, but the court did not respond.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命浙東監司發常平米振災傷州縣。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, eastern Zhe supervising commissioners were ordered to distribute ever-normal granary rice to relieve disaster-stricken prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, the court ordered eastern Zhe commissioners to open ever-normal granaries and relieve drought- and flood-stricken counties.

sentences.zh: 罷四川制置大使司所開鹽井。

translations.literal: The salt wells opened by the Sichuan Grand Pacification Commissionerate were shut down.
translations.idiomatic: The court closed the salt wells opened under the Sichuan grand pacification commissionerate.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，復罷同安監鑄錢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiawu, the Tong'an Mint's coin casting was again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day jiawu, the court again shut down minting at the Tong'an supervisory office.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Jin dispatched envoys to offer felicitations for the coming New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, the Jin court sent envoys with New Year's greetings for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，黎州蠻畜卜始降。

translations.literal: That year, the barbarian Chu Bu of Li Prefecture first submitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Li Prefecture tribesman Chu Bu surrendered for the first time.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛未，命師禹嗣秀王。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on the day xinwei, Shi Yu was ordered to succeed to the Prince of Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eighth year of Jiading (1215), on the day xinwei in the first month, Shi Yu was appointed to succeed to the title Prince of Xiu.

sentences.zh: 詔侍從、兩省、台諫各舉將材三人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, the two provincial administrations, and censorate remonstrators each to recommend three men of military talent.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered palace attendants, officials of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and remonstrance censors each to nominate three candidates for military command.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣丁焴賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Ding Yu was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, Ding Yu was sent to the Jin court to offer birthday felicitations to the Jin emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，申嚴銷金鋪翠之禁。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the prohibition on gold-inlay and kingfisher-feather ornamentation was sternly reenforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, the court strictly reenforced the ban on gold filigree work and kingfisher-feather inlay.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，雷孝友罷。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day bingwu, Lei Xiaoyou was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day bingwu, Lei Xiaoyou was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蠲平江等五郡逋負米，釋其系囚。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, overdue grain levies of Pingjiang and five other prefectures were remitted, and their imprisoned persons were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, the court remitted unpaid grain debts in Pingjiang and four other prefectures and freed prisoners held for those arrears.

sentences.zh: 己未，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，詔大郡歲舉廉吏二人，小郡一人。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinyou, an edict ordered that large prefectures each year recommend two incorrupt officials and small prefectures one.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day xinyou, the court required large prefectures annually to nominate two honest officials and small prefectures one each.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以旱，命諸路州縣禱雨。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, because of drought, all circuit prefectures and counties were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, citing drought, the throne ordered rain prayers throughout all circuits.

sentences.zh: 丙子，蠲臨安府茶鹽賞錢。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Lin'an Prefecture's tea-and-salt bounty money was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, Lin'an's supplementary tea-and-salt levy payments were waived.

sentences.zh: 釋兩浙諸州系囚。

translations.literal: Imprisoned persons of all prefectures in the Two-Zhe region were released.
translations.idiomatic: The court freed prisoners held in the Two-Zhe circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，應賢良方正能直言極諫科何致坐妄造事端、營惑衆聽，配廣西牢城。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, He Zhi, who had entered the Exalted Worthies and Direct Remonstrance examination, was sentenced for fabricating incidents and agitating public opinion, and was banished to Laocheng in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, examination graduate He Zhi was convicted of inventing disturbances and misleading public opinion and was exiled to Laocheng penal colony in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，安定郡王伯柷薨。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Prince of Anding Jun Boqiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, Prince of Anding Boqiu died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，釋江、淮闕雨州郡杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, prisoners subject to the cane and below in Yangzi and Huai regions lacking rain were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, the court freed prisoners sentenced to beating or lesser punishment in drought-stricken counties along the Yangzi and Huai.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，幸太一宮、明慶寺禱雨。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yiwei, the emperor visited the Palace of the Grand One and Mingqing Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yiwei, the emperor went to the Grand Unity Palace and Mingqing Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, he avoided the principal hall and reduced his fare.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, the emperor withdrew from the main audience hall and cut back court meals as a drought penance.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禱雨於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, rain was prayed for at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, the court held rain prayers at the altars of Heaven and Earth, the imperial ancestral shrines, and the state altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔中外臣民直言時政得失。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict called on inner and outer subjects to speak frankly on the gains and losses of current policy.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, the throne invited officials and commoners alike to speak frankly on the successes and failures of current governance.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，減臨安及諸路雜犯死罪以下囚，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, sentences of miscellaneous offenders in Lin'an and all circuits were reduced below death, and those subject to the cane and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, the court commuted miscellaneous capital and lesser sentences in Lin'an and all circuits, and freed those liable only to beating or lighter punishment.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinwei, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day xinwei, rain finally fell.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命利州路安撫司招刺忠義人。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the Lizhou Circuit Pacification Commission was ordered to recruit loyal and righteous volunteers.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, the Lizhou pacification office was directed to recruit local volunteers pledged to loyal service.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，御正殿，復膳。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the emperor took the principal hall and restored his fare.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, the emperor returned to the main hall and restored normal court meals.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復命有司禱雨。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, relevant offices were again ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, the court again ordered officials to conduct rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔贓吏毋得減年參選，著爲令。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict declared that corrupt officials might not have years subtracted for examination candidacy, and this was entered as statute.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, the throne barred corrupt officials from shaving years off their waiting period for office and codified the rule as permanent law.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，發米振糶臨安府貧民。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, grain was issued to sell at relief price to the poor of Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, the court released grain for subsidized sale to the poor in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，詔兩浙、江、淮路諭民雜種粟麥麻豆，有司毋收其賦，田主毋責其租。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingchen, an edict to the Two-Zhe, Yangzi, and Huai circuits instructed the people to plant mixed crops of millet, wheat, hemp, and beans; officials were not to collect taxes thereon, and landowners were not to exact rent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day bingchen, the court told circuits in Zhejiang and along the Yangzi and Huai to encourage planting of supplementary grains and legumes, forbade officials to tax such plots, and barred landlords from collecting rent on them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，以鄭昭先參知政事，禮部尚書曾從龍簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinyou, Zheng Zhaoxian was made Vice Grand Councilor; Minister of Rites Zeng Conglong was appointed to sign Pacification Commission affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinyou, Zheng Zhaoxian became vice grand councilor and Minister of Rites Zeng Conglong was assigned to sign documents for the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔四川立楊巨源廟，名曰褒忠。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Sichuan was ordered to erect a temple to Yang Juyuan, named Bao Zhong ("Commendation of Loyalty").
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, the throne ordered Sichuan to build a shrine to Yang Juyuan under the name Hall of Commended Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，蠲兩淮諸州今年秋稅並極邊五州明年夏稅。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, autumn land tax of all Two-Huai prefectures for this year and summer land tax of the five extreme-border prefectures for next year were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, the court remitted this year's autumn tax throughout the Two Huai region and next summer's tax in five frontier prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，蠲臨安、紹興二府貧民夏稅。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, summer land tax of the poor in Lin'an and Shaoxing were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, summer taxes owed by the poor in Lin'an and Shaoxing were waived.

sentences.zh: 丙子，發米三十萬石振糶江東饑民。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, 300,000 shi of grain were issued for relief sale to famine sufferers in Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, the court released three hundred thousand shi of grain for subsidized sale to famine victims in Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔弟搢更名思正，侄均更名貴和。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, an edict changed the younger brother Jian's name to Sizheng and the nephew Jun's name to Guihe.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, the emperor renamed his younger brother Jian as Sizheng and his nephew Jun as Guihe.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔職田蠲放如民田，違者坐之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict declared that official-fields remissions should match those for civilian fields; violators would be prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, the throne ordered official-field tax relief to match private-field exemptions, with penalties for noncompliance.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，賜張栻諡曰宣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jichou, Zhang Shi was granted the posthumous title Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day jichou, Zhang Shi was posthumously titled Xuan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，申嚴宗子訓名法。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the law on taboo names for imperial clansmen was sternly reenforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, the court strictly reenforced naming taboos for members of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，權罷旱傷州縣比較賞罰。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, comparative rewards and punishments for drought-stricken prefectures and counties were provisionally suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, the court temporarily suspended merit ratings used to reward or punish drought-hit counties.

sentences.zh: 己酉，禁州縣遏糴。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, prefectures and counties were forbidden to obstruct grain purchases.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou, the throne banned local governments from blocking private grain purchases needed for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，蘭州盜程彥暉求內附，四川制置使董居誼卻之。

translations.literal: That month, the bandit Cheng Yanhui of Lanzhou sought to submit inward; Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Dong Juyi refused him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Cheng Yanhui, a Lanzhou rebel, requested annexation to the Song, but Sichuan pacification commissioner Dong Juyi turned him away.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，朝獻于景靈宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jisi, offerings were presented at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jisi, the emperor presented offerings at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，朝饗於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the court banqueted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, the emperor offered the ancestral feast at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，合祭天地於明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, the court performed the joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth in the Bright Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，申嚴兩浙圍田之禁。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the prohibition on polder fields in the Two-Zhe region was sternly reenforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, the court strictly reenforced the ban on unauthorized polder reclamation in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，罷四川法科試。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Sichuan's legal-examination was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, the court abolished the specialized legal examination in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，命六部各類赦書寬恤事，下諸路監司推行。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day yiwei, the six ministries were ordered each to classify amnesty items of leniency and relief and send them down to circuit supervisors for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day yiwei, each of the six ministries was told to itemize amnesty relief measures and dispatch them to circuit commissioners for enforcement.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金遣使來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the Ruqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, Jin envoys arrived bearing felicitations for the emperor's birthday festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰朔，封伯澤爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day of the month bingchen, Boze was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, the day bingchen, Boze was created Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣施累使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Shi Lei was dispatched as envoy to Jin for New Year's Day felicitations.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Shi Lei was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，詔楊巨源、李好義子孫各進一官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jichou, an edict advanced the descendants of Yang Juyuan and Li Haoyi each one rank in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day jichou, the court promoted each descendant of Yang Juyuan and Li Haoyi one bureaucratic rank.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Jin dispatched envoys to offer felicitations for the coming New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, the Jin court sent envoys with New Year's greetings for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙、江東西路旱蝗。

translations.literal: That year, the Two-Zhe and Jiangdong and Jiangxi circuits suffered drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought and locust plagues struck Zhejiang, Jiangdong, and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月乙丑，賜呂祖謙諡曰成。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on the day yichou, Lü Zuqian was granted the posthumous title Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the ninth year (1216), on the day yichou in the first month, Lü Zuqian was posthumously titled Cheng.

sentences.zh: 置馬軍司水軍。

translations.literal: A naval force of the Horse Army Command was established.
translations.idiomatic: The court established a naval unit under the Palace Cavalry Command.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣留筠賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Liu Yun was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, Liu Yun was sent to the Jin court for the emperor's birthday felicitations.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命諸州招填軍籍。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, all prefectures were ordered to recruit and fill army registers.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, the throne ordered every prefecture to recruit replacements to fill gaps in military rolls.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷諸路旱蝗州縣和糴及四川關外科糴。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, equitable purchase in drought- and locust-stricken prefectures and counties of all circuits and extramural grain procurement in Sichuan were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, the court suspended equitable grain purchases in drought- and locust-hit counties nationwide and canceled extramural grain levies in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day of the month jiashen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, the day jiashen, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，東西兩川地大震。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, eastern and western Sichuan were greatly shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, a major earthquake struck eastern and western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，又震。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yimao, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day yimao, the earth quaked again.

sentences.zh: 甲子，又震，馬湖夷界山崩八十里，江水不通。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, it shook again; mountains collapsed for eighty li in the Mahu Yi border region, and the river water did not flow.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, another quake struck; eighty li of mountains collapsed along the Mahu tribal frontier, damming the river.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，又震。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, the earth quaked again.

sentences.zh: 壬申，又震。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, another tremor occurred.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔侍從、台諫、兩省舉堪監司者各二人。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, censorate remonstrators, and the two provincial administrations each to recommend two men fit to be circuit supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, the throne required palace attendants, remonstrance censors, and Secretariat and Chancellery officials each to nominate two candidates for circuit commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，秦州人唐進與其徒何進等引衆十萬來歸，四川制置使董居誼拒卻之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wuxu, Tang Jin of Qin Prefecture with his followers He Jin and others led a host of 100,000 to submit; Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Dong Juyi refused them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day wuxu, Tang Jin of Qinzhou marched in with He Jin and others at the head of a hundred thousand men seeking surrender; Dong Juyi again refused them.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guiyou, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day guiyou, Venus was visible in daylight—an ominous portent.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，西川地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinmao, western Sichuan was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day xinmao, western Sichuan was hit by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，又震。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, the earth quaked again.

sentences.zh: 乙未，又震，黎州山崩。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, it shook again; mountains in Li Prefecture collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, another quake struck and mountains collapsed in Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，振恤浙西被水州縣，寬其租稅。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, flood-stricken prefectures and counties of western Zhe were relieved and their land tax and levies eased.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, the court provided disaster relief to flood-hit counties in western Zhejiang and reduced their taxes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，詔邊縣擇才不拘常法，其餘並遵三年之制。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day wuchen, an edict declared that border counties might select talent without regard to regular rules, while all others should follow the three-year system.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuchen, the throne allowed frontier counties to appoint talent by exceptional rules while requiring all others to adhere to the standard three-year tenure.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，詔兩浙、江東監司核州縣被水最甚者，蠲其租。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiashen, an edict ordered supervising commissioners of Two-Zhe and Jiangdong to verify the prefectures and counties most severely inundated and remit their rent.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jiashen, Zhejiang and Jiangdong commissioners were directed to identify the worst flood damage and waive rent in those counties.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，西川地震。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day guihai, western Sichuan was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guihai, western Sichuan suffered another earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲子，又震。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, the ground trembled again.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，金遣使來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the Ruqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, Jin envoys arrived with birthday festival felicitations.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，遣陳伯震使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengyin, Chen Bozhen was dispatched as envoy to Jin for New Year's Day felicitations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day gengyin, Chen Bozhen was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以程彥暉攻圍鞏州，迫及川界，命利州副都統劉昌祖移駐西和州以備之。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, because Cheng Yanhui was attacking and besieging Gongzhou, pressing on the Sichuan border, Vice Commander-in-chief Liu Changzu of Lizhou was ordered to shift his garrison to Xihe Prefecture to guard against him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, with Cheng Yanhui besieging Gongzhou and threatening the Sichuan frontier, the court ordered Lizhou deputy commander Liu Changzu to move his troops to Xihe Prefecture in defense.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，再給諸軍雪寒錢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingsi, snow-and-cold money was again issued to all armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day dingsi, the court again disbursed winter hardship allowances to the troops.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Jin dispatched envoys to offer felicitations for the coming New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, the Jin court sent envoys with New Year's greetings for the coming year.
